instruction: A cinematic medium shot of a studio setting with a soft pastel pink and blue gradient background. On the left, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) stands facing forward, smiling warmly at the camera while dancing with her arms spread wide. Beside her on the right, the man in the white t-shirt and black vest (R2) stands facing forward, looking down with a focused expression as he dances with his hands raised. The two dance side-by-side without physical contact. The scene is illuminated by soft, colorful studio lighting that casts a gentle glow, creating a vibrant and energetic atmosphere.
